He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==High school career== Born in [[Markham, Ontario]], he started playing high school basketball at Christian Faith Center Academy in [[North Carolina]]. However, the NCAA was declining to accept credits received from the school, prompting him to transfer to [[Huntington Prep School]] in [[West Virginia]]. At Huntington Prep School, he played with current [[NBA]] player [[Andrew Wiggins]], and he was considered a top 30 player in his class (2013).{{cite web|url=http://www.sportsnet.ca/basketball/nba/florida-statement-xavier-rathan-mayes-ready-closeup/|title=Florida Statement|author=Dave Zarum|work=Sportsnet}} ==College career== [[Image:Xavier Rathan-Mayes vs. Florida (cropped).jpg|thumb|left|150px|Rathan-Mayes with [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] in December 2014]] Rathan-Mayes played three years of [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]] between 2014 and 2017.{{cite web|url=http://www.dukebasketballreport.com/2015/1/25/7886743/florida-states-xavier-rathan-mayes-joins-an-elite-group|title=Florida State's Xavier Rathan-Mayes joins an elite group|author=Barry Jacobs|work=Duke Basketball Report|date=25 January 2015}} As a freshman in 2014–15, Rathan-Mayes had three games with 30 points or more.{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/ncaab-the-dagger/xavier-rathan-mayes-erupts-for-30-points-in-four-plus-minutes-071437746.html|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes erupts for 30 points in four-plus minutes|author=Jeff Eisenberg|work=Yahoo}}{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/3059247/xavier-rathan-mayes|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes Game-by-Game Stats|work=ESPN}} He averaged 14.9 points per game, becoming only the second freshman to lead Florida State in scoring. He was named to the All-ACC Freshman Team.{{cite web|url=http://www.foxsports.com/florida/story/florida-state-seminoles-xavier-rathan-mayes-return-sophomore-season-040215|title=FSU's Xavier Rathan-Mayes returning for sophomore season|author=Bob Ferrante|work=Fox Sports Florida|date=2 April 2015}} He averaged 11.8 points in 2015–16 and 10.6 points in 2016–17. In 2017, he graduated from Florida State University with a degree in Sociology.{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/xavier-rathan-mayes-1.html|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes|work=sports-reference.com|access-date=August 3, 2022}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2017 NBA draft]], Rathan-Mayes played for the [[New York Knicks]] in the [[2017 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]] and then joined the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]] for the 2017–18 season.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Xavier-Rathan-Mayes/Summary/27051|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes|work=realgm.com|access-date=August 3, 2022}} On March 5, 2018, he signed a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite news|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Xavier Rathan-Mayes to 10-day contract|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-xavier-rathan-mayes-180305|date=March 5, 2018|work=NBA.com|access-date=March 5, 2018}} He played five games for the Grizzlies.{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/r/rathaxa01/gamelog/2018|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes 2017-18 Game Log|work=basketball-reference.com|access-date=February 9, 2023}} After playing for the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] in the [[2018 NBA Summer League]],{{cite news|title=Rathan-Mayes joins Lakers for Summer League|url=https://www.wctv.tv/content/news/Rathan-Mayes-joins-Lakers-for-Summer-League-486860231.html|date=June 28, 2018|work=WCTV.tv|access-date=March 29, 2019}} Rathan-Mayes joined [[AEK B.C.|AEK Athens]] of the [[Greek Basket League]] for the 2018–19 season.{{cite news|title=AEK B.C. signs Mayes|url=http://aekbc.gr/en/articles-2408/aek-b-c-signs-mayes.htm|date=July 28, 2018|work=aekbc.gr|access-date=July 28, 2018|archive-date=December 6, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221206212030/https://aekbc.gr/en/articles-2408/aek-b-c-signs-mayes.htm|url-status=dead}} His final game for AEK came on December 29, 2018.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.australiabasket.com/player/Xavier-Rathan-Mayes/Australia/Melbourne-United/225300|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes|work=australiabasket.com|access-date=August 3, 2022|url-access=subscription}} On January 8, 2019, he was acquired by the [[Texas Legends]] of the NBA G League.{{cite news|first1=Britney|last1=Wynn|title=Legends Acquire Xavier Rathan-Mayes|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-acquire-xavier-rathan-mayes/|date=January 8, 2019|work=NBA.com|access-date=January 8, 2019|archive-date=December 7, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211207021556/https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-acquire-xavier-rathan-mayes/|url-status=dead}} In 25 games played for the Legends, he averaged 14.2 points, 4.6 rebounds, 6 assists and 1.1 steals per game. On March 28, 2019, he signed with [[Bnei Herzliya]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Israeli Premier League]] for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=רכש לבני הרצליה: רת'אן-מייז חתם|url=http://basket.co.il/news.asp?id=21014|date=March 28, 2019|work=basket.co.il|access-date=March 28, 2019|language=he}} On April 22, 2019, he recorded a season-high 28 points, shooting 6-of-11 from three-point range, along with five rebounds and three assists in a 76–72 win over [[Ironi Nahariya]]. He was subsequently named [[2018–19 Israeli Basketball Premier League#MVP of the Round|Israeli League Round 28 MVP]].{{cite web|title=מצטיין המחזור ה-28: אקסבייר רת'אן-מייז|url=http://basket.co.il/news.asp?id=21124|access-date=April 22, 2019|work=basket.co.il|date=April 22, 2019|language=he}} In July and August 2019, Rathan-Mayes played with the [[Hamilton Honey Badgers]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]] (CEBL). He helped the team reach the final of the [[2019 CEBL season|2019 season]], scoring 24 points in a loss to the [[Saskatchewan Rattlers]]. In October 2019, Rathan-Mayes re-joined the Texas Legends.{{Cite web|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-draft-two-announce-training-camp-roster-2|title=Legends Draft Two, Announce Training 3, 2019, he was acquired by the [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] in a trade.{{Cite web|url=https://aguacaliente.gleague.nba.com/news/agua-caliente-clippers-acquire-xavier-rathan-mayes|title=AGUA CALIENTE 2019}} On February 26, 2021, Rathan-Mayes joined [[CSU Sibiu]] of the [[Liga Națională (men's basketball)|Romanian National League]].{{Cite web|url=https://bc-csusibiu.ro/stiri/xavier-rathan-mayes-este-noul-jucator-al-bc-csu-sibiu|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes este noul jucător al BC CSU Sibiu|date=February 26, 2021|website=bc-csusibiu.ro|access-date=February 26, 2021|language=Romanian}} On October 18, 2021, Rathan-Mayes signed with the [[Illawarra Hawks]] in Australia for the [[2021–22 NBL season]].{{Cite web|title=Hawks grab Xavier Rathan-Mayes to complete NBL roster|url=https://www.hawks.com.au/news/hawks-grab-xavier-rathan-mayes-to-complete-nbl-roster|website=Hawks.com.au|date=October 18, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2021}} In May 2022, Rathan-Mayes joined the [[Scarborough Shooting Stars]] of the CEBL. He played six games between May 26 and June 18. On August 3, 2022, Rathan-Mayes signed with [[Melbourne United]] in Australia for the [[2022–23 NBL season]].{{Cite web|title=United sign former Hawks, NBA guard Xavier Rathan-Mayes|url=https://www.melbourneutd.com.au/news/united-sign-former-hawks-nba-guard-xavier-rathan-mayes|website=melbourneutd.com.au|date=August 3, 2022|access-date=August 3, 2022}} In his debut for United on October 2, 2022, he recorded 33 points, nine rebounds, and five assists in a 101–97 overtime win over the [[New Zealand Breakers]].{{Cite web|title=United edge NBL thriller over Breakers|url=https://www.espn.com.au/nbl/story/_/id/34704595/nbl-round-1-united-edge-nbl-thriller-breakers|website=espn.com.au|date=October 2, 2022|access-date=February 9, 2023}} On February 9, 2023, he signed with [[Merkezefendi Belediyesi Denizli Basket|Merkezefendi Bld. Denizli Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish Basketball Super League]] (BSL).{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketfaul.com/haber?haber=106340|title=Merkezefendi'ye Kanadalı guard|last=|first=|date=February 9, 2023|website=|publisher=basketfaul|language=tr|access-date=February 9, 2023}} Rathan-Mayes spent the 2023-2024 campaign with Russian club [[BC Enisey]], averaging a career-high of 25.4 points, 4.2 rebounds and 4.5 assists per game. On July 12, 2024, Rathan-Mayes signed a two-year contract with Spanish powerhouse [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], moving to the [[EuroLeague]] for the first time in his career. On July 8, 2026, Rathan-Mayes signed with [[BC UNICS|UNICS Kazan]] of the [[VTB United League]].{{cite web |title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes (ex Bayern) signs at UNICS Kazan |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Russia/news/1007286/Xavier-Rathan-Mayes-ex-Bayern-signs-at-UNICS-Kazan |website=Eurobasket |access-date=July 10, 2026 |date=July 8, 2026}} ==National team career== Rathan-Mayes represented his country, [[Canada men's national basketball team|Canada]], five games in international competition.{{cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/players/196177-xavier-rathan-mayes#career-stats|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes|work=FIBA Basketball|access-date=2025-03-01}} He participated at the 2012 U-18 Americas Championship and the [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2013 U-19 World Championship]].{{cite web|url=http://www.basketball.ca/files/2015-02/xavier_rathan_mayes_profile.pdf|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes|work=Canada Basketball|access-date=2015-09-21|archive-date=2016-10-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161012095443/http://www.basketball.ca/files/2015-02/xavier_rathan_mayes_profile.pdf|url-status=dead}} ==Personal life== His [[stepfather]] is former NBA player [[Tharon Mayes]].{{cite web|url=http://borgesblognhr.blogspot.ca/2012/08/tharon-mayes-giving-guidance-to-inner.html|title=Tharon Mayes Giving Guidance To Inner City Kids...And His Highly-Touted Son|author=David Borges|work=New Haven Register}} Rathan-Mayes has an Australian wife who lives in [[Sydney]], [[Australia]] and they have one daughter.{{cite web|url=https://www.sportingnews.com/au/basketball/news/xavier-rathan-mayes-canadian-california-streetball-culture-sydney/gbdypbg9ys9lflvswylqr0kf|title=Xavier Rathan-Mayes, the Canadian hooper bringing California streetball culture to Sydney|author=Jed Wells|work=SportingNews.com|date=13 July 2023|access-date=14 July 2023}} He also enjoys golfing in his spare time. ==Career
